definition.account_entitlement: The exact provider credential, account, and project that will execute an EXP-001 subject is currently permitted by OpenAI to invoke the preregistered model through the exact required API surface.
not_equivalent: the model appears in public documentation
some OpenAI model can be invoked
the organization has general API access

candidate_mechanisms.proves: OpenAI publicly documents gpt-5.6-sol, Responses API compatibility, limits, prices, and the published snapshot table at retrieval time.
candidate_mechanisms.does_not_prove: Any credential, organization, or project may invoke it.

candidate_mechanisms.proves: An authenticated credential received a model catalogue in which the requested identifier may appear.
candidate_mechanisms.does_not_prove: The documentation does not state that list inclusion guarantees invocation through /v1/responses for that exact project at launch time.
candidate_mechanisms.account_or_project_specific: credential-scoped response; exact project semantics must be recorded

candidate_mechanisms.proves: An authenticated GET returned basic metadata for a model identifier, including owner and permissioning-oriented metadata.
candidate_mechanisms.does_not_prove: The reference does not promise that retrieval success equals permission to invoke the model through Responses.
candidate_mechanisms.account_or_project_specific: credential-scoped response; no returned project identity is documented

candidate_mechanisms.proves: An organization admin read the exact project's allow-list or deny-list model policy.
candidate_mechanisms.does_not_prove: An allow policy does not by itself prove organization-wide provisioning, credential usability, billing, nonzero limits, or successful Responses invocation.

candidate_mechanisms.proves: An organization admin read model-specific rate-limit configuration for the exact project.
candidate_mechanisms.does_not_prove: The reference does not state that a rate-limit row grants model invocation entitlement.

candidate_mechanisms.proves: Provider-returned project, API-key, service-account, and owner-access identifiers can bind non-secret evidence to the intended execution credential and project.
candidate_mechanisms.does_not_prove: An active project and credential do not establish model-specific Responses entitlement.

entitlement_policy.entitled_requirement: ENTITLED requires a current official OpenAI statement that a named non-inference response guarantees the exact credential/project may invoke the exact model through /v1/responses, plus successful evidence from that mechanism.
entitlement_policy.freshness_rule: Run once before reading or claiming live authorization, validate the unconsumed authorization set, then repeat immediately before atomic authorization consumption. Evidence must be no more than 300 seconds old at consumption.
entitlement_policy.failure_behavior: Only ENTITLED may pass the future launch gate. Every other classification blocks before authorization consumption.

credential_privacy.reason: Credential rotation would change a key hash without changing the account/project, while a retained key-derived hash unnecessarily fingerprints secret material.

model_identity_policy.required_prelaunch_identity: An exact provider-published immutable dated snapshot ID for GPT-5.6 Sol, preregistered by versioned amendment and invoked directly.
model_identity_policy.runtime_capture: Capture the Responses response.model field and require exact equality with the preregistered immutable snapshot ID.
model_identity_policy.runtime_fingerprint: No Responses provider revision/fingerprint field is documented for this model. Chat Completions system_fingerprint is deprecated and is not a substitute for an immutable Responses model ID.

documentation_snapshot_policy.purpose: Content-addressed minimum public facts prove what official documentation stated at retrieval time.
does_not_prove: provider availability at a later time
the implementation actually served at runtime

no_accidental_inference_probe: Account/model readiness may not be tested by sending a disposable completion merely to see whether it works. Without a documented non-inference entitlement mechanism, classification remains UNVERIFIED unless a separately authorized readiness-probe protocol is created.
